title: The demo for my story-driven, choice-based kingdom management game is now playable!
author: RadiantExternal8752
selftext:
I've finally made the demo of my choice-based kingdom management game playable! Hello, I wanted to share my choice-based kingdom management game with you. I created the story entirely with my wife, and the coding was done with the help of AI. Most of the assets are placeholders. I used ready-made assets and a few amateur pixel art assets that I could easily create. I wanted to create a game similar to Reigns. Our goal is to keep the kingdom we choose alive for as long as possible through our choices. The game's premise is as follows: There are 5 kingdoms. Four of them are based on the four basic elements, and the other is the nature kingdom. Our goal is to choose one of these kingdoms and progress through the game by selecting one of three options in the events that unfold. We can engage in activities such as trade, cooperation, and war with other kingdoms. The lore includes a fictional history. Currently, only the Fire Kingdom is playable. The Water Kingdom is our natural enemy, and we start the game on bad terms. The Air Kingdom is one we get along well with. We've also added a number of major events to the game; choosing these triggers subsequent options. 

If you'd like to play and test it and give feedback, you can check it out via your browser here:

https://aygforge.itch.io/elementumkingdoms 

All feedback is very important to us. Thank you for all your suggestions.
